question.text: A company was voluntarily delisted in 2023. The earliest year it can re-apply for listing on a stock exchange is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI Delisting Regulations, an application for listing of equity shares delisted under voluntary delisting shall not be made for 3 years from the date of delisting. If delisted in 2023, the earliest re-application year is 2026 (2023 + 3 years). The Trap: "2028" confuses the voluntary delisting bar with the separate 10-year securities-market/listing bar applicable to compulsory delisting. Voluntary delisting carries a 3-year relisting bar; compulsory delisting carries a 10-year bar. Note: Keep the two regimes separate — voluntary delisting = 3-year relisting bar; compulsory delisting = 10-year securities-market/listing bar.
